Deliberate: the ~4px cluster is the print border, which is the world's one material constant and is uniform on purpose (direction contract OWN-WORLD: prints sitting flat with thin white borders). The page's actual rhythm runs on a separate 8-14-22-36-56px scale, visible between tiles, days and sections.

Two deliberate uses, neither decorative striping: the enamel speckle that makes the panel read as a surface rather than a flat fill, and the scrubber graticule, which is a measured ruling so a pinned note stands at a readable position (direction contract RAISE, nixie and jackfield donations).
